description: This file provides PHP4 session management using the ADODB database wrapper library, including encryption and database interaction functions for session handling.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: Class used for encrypting and decrypting session data with MD5-based cryptography.

methods.name: ADODB_Session_Key
methods.description: Creates an encrypted session key using a fixed cryptographic key and session ID as salt.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Initializes database connection for session handling.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database, decrypting it.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Encrypts and writes session data to the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to remove expired sessions.
